Come to EAI and Discover the feelings of:

Come experience why so many employees have been with EAI for 5 - 10+ years, and continue to make it their home as the EAI Family expands.

Responsibilities

Design and integrate front-ends to visualize the workflows for Web applications custom-built for a variety of commercial clients like Cardinal Health, Ryder, TOTE Logistics and others. Work in a hands-on capacity with small, tight-knit teams in a client-interactive role, seeing the impact of your work first-hand Microsoft tech stack development on a regular basis.

Desired Skills

Creative problem solver.
Proficiency in C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, and/or ability to quickly learn Databases, APIs, and New Technologies.
High Energy / Attitude.
Familiarity with User-Centered Design.
Exposure to CS fundamentals or programming.

OPT, H1B, Permanent Residents, and US Citizens are all welcome!

We treat everyone the same - Nicely :)

 

We take care of our EAI Family :

FREE catered lunch DAILY
Paid Training (CodeAcademy, Coursera, NoFluffJustStuff, Google DevFest, pre-paid courses, mentoring)
FREE snacks/drinks - Multiple varieties of soft drinks, juices, coffee, tea, Gatorade, beer, wine & regular social gatherings.
HYBRID mode - providing flexibility to EAi Family members to mix and match with their team on working from home and collaborating in the office.

EAI has NEVER HAD LAYOFFS. We have carried our folks through multiple tough cycles, 2002, 2009, the current pandemic, and will continue to do so!

We are growing, and looking for individuals who want to be part of a fun, passionate, and highly accomplished team with Hackathons and regular events like Poker and Movie Night to keep the spirits alive.

Combine that with daily catered lunch from such restaurants as Cava, Chipotle, Plaka Grill, Jason's Deli, and Shake Shack and you can see that we strive to foster a family-friendly culture that emphasizes teamwork, camaraderie, and openness.
